notes.title: FULL GAME RELEASE!
notes.notes:
Hello Sorters!

We are happy to announce that after adding multiple features to Package Dudes, such as new types of packages, new mechanics and fixing many bugs, we decided to leave Early Access and become a fully released game!

Thank you all for your support and we hope you will have lots of fun with Package Dudes!

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 3! BIG BUG SQUASH UPDATE!
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES 3
BIG BUG SQUASH UPDATE!
Version v2023.01.31

Hello Sorters! 

We are happy to share with you a brand new Update! This time we focused on even more bug fixing but there are some changes in gameplay too! 

[New/Updated Content]

 Throwing packages into lava / out of map is no longer penalized with minus points. Don’t be afraid to try difficult or lucky throws!
 Package Spawner now have a limit of 16 packages spawned on the level at current time (for performance and to not overwhelm players)
 Disabled walk speed relative to the size of held package (wasn’t fun)
 Quad Plat level - Delay time between platforms moving increased to 1.5 seconds
 Minimum package size increased for better visibility
 Music muted setting is now saving between sessions
 Graphics setting is also saving between sessions
 Credits page have been updated to include our names :D 


[Bug Fixes]

 Fixed bug where character can’t grab any package if he was holding a package when the match before ended
 Fixed bug where character can’t grab any package if another character grabbed a package that was held by him. Taking package from another character is no longer possible
 Fixed bug where character is walking after the end of match
 Fixed bug where character sometimes can’t jump after match start
 Fixed bug where broken packages were not removed from PackageList in Package Spawner, which affected max amount of packages on the level at current time
 Fixed bug where character can’t jump on the Line

notes.title: Special Package Update!
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES 2
Special Package Delivery!
Version v2023.01.25

Hello Sorters! 

We have prepared BIG update including new types of packages, new map and bug fixes!

Have a look!

[previewyoutube=61IzQMBomtA;full][/previewyoutube]

Here is a full list of changes:

[New/Updated Content]

 Special packages - Keep Dry, Fragile, Bouncy
 If Keep Dry package touches water, it breaks into pieces (not affecting score)
 If Fragile package hits something too hard, it breaks into pieces (not affecting score)
 Updated tutorial to include special packages
 New map - #9 “Jumping Walls”!
 Menu music added
 Most moving platforms now have borders to prevent packages sliding off of them
 Updated level Tri Plat - added two bridges with puddles in the middle
 Reverted jump height dependent on package size (wasn’t fun)
 Scoreboard can now be opened anytime when not playing a match - press Tab on keyboard or Back on gamepad
Added key combination to clear scoreboard - press Delete + F11
Music muted setting is now saving between sessions


[Bug Fixes]

 Fixed Discord button link
 Adjusted Camera on 2Side Quad for better visibility of packages on further side of the level
 Fixed bug where package fallen from moving platform would still move with it
 Fixed bug where player character would respawn in the wrong place
 Fixed bug where music would restart when going from options screen to main menu
 Removed tutorial tick box from options because now it’s a dedicated level
 Fixed bug where joining green player restarted music
 Fixed bug where character at the beginning of the match was being moved like standing on the line if he was actually doing that when match before ended

notes.title: Day 1 Update v2022.12.29
notes.notes:
Hello Sorters! 

We have prepared first update including Discord server button in main menu and some bug fixes!

Here is a full list of changes:

[New/Updated Content]

 Join Discord server button
 Escape key and gamepad B button returns to main menu


[Bug Fixes]

 Tutorial text lined up
 Music now pauses on pause screen
 Fixed jump bug
 Slower character rotation to prevent excessive yeeting
 Saving graphics preset between levels
 Jump height dependent on package size
 Packages thrown in wrong drop zone or out of map now count to cumulative score
 Fixed DropZone particle effect on all maps
 Fixed bug where character couldn’t grab small packages close to him
 Fixed bug where held big packages blocked movement
 Fixed multiplying package spawn timer when playing multiple matches in a row on the same level
 Controls and Credits screen now closes when changing button focus
